reuse.why: Each month-wide action keeps its own category query and the new rule is patched into each one; no shared selection is introduced even though four actions already shared the same query text.

duplication.why: The template exclusion is written five times (four SQL clauses plus a row check in copyPreviousMonth) and setZero gains a fourth copy of the hidden/group-hidden category query.

placement.why: All edits are in budget/actions.ts where the month-wide actions live.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule is spread across five hand-synchronised queries/checks, so the next exclusion must again be added everywhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared month-wide category selection to bypass; each action had its own query.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the SQL 'c.goal_def IS NULL' and hidden clauses as per-row early returns on getBudgetData results.

one_place.where: The rule is added separately in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg in budget/actions.ts.
